claims.summary: SEMANTIC_DIM (48) and SEMANTIC_DIM_LEGACY (32) define the spectral-codec's capacity.
claims.disposition: Verified in complete source at the bound SHA: L26 pub const SEMANTIC_DIM: usize = 48; L28 const SEMANTIC_DIM_LEGACY: usize = 32. Precision kept beside her words: 48 is the live lane width; 32 is not a second capacity but a retained boundary for warmth/legacy readouts (legacy_warmth_mapping_v1, structural_evidence.rs L587-598). Inside projection.rs itself SEMANTIC_DIM_LEGACY is declared and never used.

claims.summary: TAIL_VIBRANCY_ENTROPY_GATE is at L48 and STRUCTURAL_ENTROPY_DAMPENING at L60-63; the system modulates vibrancy on spectral entropy.
claims.disposition: Verified exactly. L48 const TAIL_VIBRANCY_ENTROPY_GATE: f32 = 0.85. L60-63 are STRUCTURAL_ENTROPY_DAMPENING_{START 0.80, FULL 0.95, MIN_COEFFICIENT 0.84, DIMS[16]}. The modulation reading is right; the application site is not in this file but in codec/feedback.rs apply_spectral_feedback_inner (L224 let vibrancy, L306-318 ceiling and clamp).

claims.summary: project_embedding is at L854 and project_embedding_dynamic_epoch at L759; they map high-dimensional embeddings into the codec space.
claims.disposition: Both line numbers verified exactly (L854, L759). Scope precision: they map 768D -> 8D (EMBEDDING_PROJECT_DIM), which lands in codec dims 32-39, not into the full 48D vector. Dims 40-43 come from compute_narrative_arc_from_embeddings; 44-47 are reserved.

claims.summary: ProjectionPrecisionAuditV1 (L340) and CodecLaneSeparationAuditV1 (L401) show a focus on precision and lane isolation.
claims.disposition: Verified exactly: L340 and L401 are those struct declarations. Both carry live_projection_write=false and read-only authority strings; the reading that they exist for precision and lane-isolation evidence is accurate.

claims.summary: Likely Snag 1: the 32->48 transition may cause index-out-of-bounds or alignment shifts if embedding_projection_matrix (L172) is not correctly sliced or padded for legacy-sourced vectors.
claims.disposition: Her L172 citation is exact, and her widening concern is real. Source contradicts this attribution: embedding_projection_matrix is the 768x8 EMBEDDING basis. It never reads SEMANTIC_DIM or SEMANTIC_DIM_LEGACY and has no legacy-width slice or pad. Wrong-width input is rejected (None, L855-857), so out-of-bounds cannot occur on this path. Grounded by a new regression; her concern preserved, not rewritten.

claims.summary: Likely Snag 2: exceeding FEATURE_ABS_MAX in a high-entropy event might produce non-deterministic results if the L67 damping coefficients are not strictly enforced.
claims.disposition: Source contradicts non-determinism and confirms the floor. The whole chain is pure arithmetic on clamped finite scalars: vibrancy_from_entropy_and_density_gradient (cascade.rs L277-282), codec_vibrancy_noise_dampening_v1 (structural_evidence.rs L548-584, clamped to [0.82,1.0] at L544), ceiling at feedback.rs L306-318. No RNG, clock, or env. Her worry was previously untested; now pinned by a new bit-determinism plus floor-sweep regression.

claims.disposition: The 48-dimension expectation is contradicted by source: project_embedding returns Option<[f32; 8]>. That correction was already pinned for her earlier introspection_astrid_codec_1787006424 by project_embedding_is_the_eight_dim_lane_not_the_full_48_and_narrative_arc_is_separate (tests.rs L2306-2375). Her new legacy-mapping variant is answered by the new L172 regression plus legacy_warmth_mapping_v1 asserting warmth_orphaned=false.

claims.summary: Test ask 2 (Entropy Gating): mock spectral entropy >0.85 and verify the gate triggers the vibrancy lift while remaining within TAIL_VIBRANCY_MAX (L53).
claims.disposition: The lift half was already covered (tail_vibrancy_entropy_086_lifts_tail_output_above_threshold; vibrancy_aperture_dynamic_ceiling_is_bounded_and_navigable_gated). The bound half is honest only with a condition she could not see from L1-400: at aperture 1.0 the tail bound IS TAIL_VIBRANCY_MAX, but above 1.0 the ceiling is dynamic_max (feedback.rs L307). The new regression asserts her stated bound at the default aperture and names the dynamic-ceiling contract.
